segments: Power Generator 6, then take the part from the reward chest beside it.
Kill the first Panzer Soldat (normally Round 8) and pick up the part it drops.
After the church path is open, shoot down the orange glowing plane and collect the fallen part near the Excavation mound.
Check its three spawn points in the Church / Generator 6 area.
On the floor inside the Excavation, next to a table.

Around the outside of the Excavation: by the Excavation sign, in the wheelbarrow by Pack-a-Punch, or in the trench by the church debris. Play it on the table inside the Excavation to open the stairs down to the staff pedestals.
Take the red record and Gramophone to the Fire Tunnel near spawn, enter the Crazy Place, and collect the red crystal.
Use the red pedestal beneath the Excavation Site.
In the Crazy Place, kill about 30 zombies with the Fire Staff while they stand on the metal grates, until all four cauldrons are lit.
Go upstairs in the Church: four symbols are lit on the far wall. Turn each into a number with the chart.

In the Church basement (where the tank parks), light the four matching numbered torches with the Fire Staff before the puzzle resets. 4 is always one of them; its torch has a bloodstain instead of a chalk number.
At the Excavation Site, use the four levers to align every ring to RED.
Go below the rings and shoot the red orb with the Fire Staff.
Return to the Crazy Place and place the Fire Staff on the red pedestal.
Kill zombies around the pedestal until the staff is fully charged, then pick it up.
